review.reviewer: Codex implementation owner, self-review; not independent approval
review.decision: Keep ordinary client read contracts unchanged and make historical observation explicit at UI call sites
review.notes: Exact candidate CI exposed four legacy API assertions: unconditional observation query and malformed response shape. Preserve original assertions rather than weakening them. Review before new/changed tests. Production screens/Trace explicitly opt in; observation never grants send authority. Synthetic responses only.

cases.description: Observed reads are explicit while ordinary transcript and trace contracts remain compatible
cases.setup: Actual GtmuxClient with isolated fetch; existing legacy API/history assertions unchanged. Existing SID006 API regression is updated to make its observation request explicit.
cases.action: Read ordinary and opt-in recent transcripts, malformed response and 304; read ordinary/opt-in pane Trace and external Trace.
cases.expected: Default URLs and malformed empty result remain exactly compatible. Only explicit UI observation requests add observation=1, preserving recent/context/cursor/conditional headers. Last-known state survives 304; verified removes restriction. External session routes retain their exact identity and never receive observation fallback. Detail/HQ/Trace UI opt in, input paths unchanged. No network/session/device operations.
